cues.en: Hello everyone.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: Sitting next to me is my wife Lisbeth and here we are comparing the sound spectra of our voices.
cues.zh: 坐在我旁边的是我妻子 Lisbeth，我们正在比较我们声音的声谱。

cues.en: Even though we are trying to sing the same note, our voices sound quite different. And I was curious if one could easily see the difference in an audio spectrum.
cues.zh: 虽然我们试着唱同一个音，但我们的声音听起来很不一样；我很好奇，在音频频谱里是否能轻易看出这种差异。

cues.en: For this experiment, I used a free app from the Google Play Store called Spectroid.
cues.zh: 这个实验里，我用了一个 Google Play Store 上的免费应用，叫 Spectroid。

cues.en: And here you see the spectra of our voices, displaying the frequency scale on the horizontal axis
cues.zh: 这里看到的是我们声音的频谱，横轴显示频率刻度

cues.en: and the amplitude as a lighter color.
cues.zh: 振幅则用较浅的颜色表示。

cues.en: And as you can see, there are indeed differences between the audio spectra,
cues.zh: 如你所见，这些音频频谱之间确实有差异，

cues.en: especially here in the region of the overtones.
cues.zh: 尤其是在泛音区域这里。

cues.en: And it is exactly these differences that allow for discriminating
cues.zh: 正是这些差异让我们能够区分

cues.en: between voices,
cues.zh: 不同的声音，

cues.en: not only for a smart phone, but also for a human.
cues.zh: 不仅智能手机能做到，人也能做到。

cues.en: For humans, distinguishing between different voices comes sort of naturally.
cues.zh: 对人类来说，区分不同声音有点像是天生的。

cues.en: We also use spectral analysis to do this, and in fact we have a very advanced piece of hardware in our ear called the cochlea.
cues.zh: 我们做这件事也用频谱分析；事实上，我们耳朵里有一块非常先进的“硬件”，叫耳蜗。

cues.en: It contains a thin membrane in a sort of spiral shaped void,
cues.zh: 它里面有一层薄膜，位于一个螺旋形的腔体中，

cues.en: which is connected to a large number of hearing nerves.
cues.zh: 这层膜连接着大量听觉神经。

cues.en: Each frequency it picks up is transmitted over a separate nerve to the brain.
cues.zh: 它接收到的每个频率都通过单独的神经传到大脑。

cues.en: So, the complex sound waves reaching our ears are first translated to frequency spectra.
cues.zh: 所以，到达耳朵的复杂声波首先会被转换成频谱。

cues.en: And in a sense, our brains are not processing the audio signals directly,
cues.zh: 某种意义上，我们的大脑并不是直接处理音频信号，

cues.en: but the audio spectra of the signals.
cues.zh: 而是处理信号的音频频谱。

cues.en: But as you have seen with the smartphone,
cues.zh: 但正如你在智能手机上看到的，

cues.en: the conversion of an audio signal to a frequency spectrum can also be done in software.
cues.zh: 把音频信号转换成频谱也可以用软件完成。

cues.en: And in the case of the smartphone, an algorithm called Fast Fourier transform is used, which is a numerical implementation
cues.zh: 在智能手机这个例子里，用的是一种叫 Fast Fourier transform 的算法，它是一种数值实现，即

cues.en: of the Fourier Transform invented by Joseph Fourier in the late eighteenth century.
cues.zh: Joseph Fourier 在十八世纪末发明的 Fourier Transform。

cues.en: Because the theory of Fourier Transforms is actually pretty advanced, we will not take a deep dive into it. Instead, I'll just do a bit of shallow pedaling for a few minutes.
cues.zh: 因为 Fourier Transform 的理论其实相当高深，我们不会深入讲；我只用几分钟简单带一下。

cues.en: As an example, let's consider a signal which varies in time.
cues.zh: 举个例子，考虑一个随时间变化的信号。

cues.en: And we know that this signal contains several different frequencies.
cues.zh: 我们知道这个信号包含好几个不同频率。

cues.en: To find out if a specific frequency is in the signal, we can multiply the signal with the frequency under test. And by multiplication I mean value by value in each of the curves.
cues.zh: 要判断某个特定频率是否在信号中，可以把信号与待测频率相乘；我说的相乘，是指每条曲线上逐值相乘。

cues.en: The result of this multiplication is for example this curve.
cues.zh: 相乘的结果例如就是这条曲线。

cues.en: The next thing we can do is take the resulting curve and integrate all the values over time.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们可以把得到的曲线对所有值做时间积分。

cues.en: So basically this process involves adding up all the values in the curve.
cues.zh: 所以这个过程基本上就是把曲线里的所有值加起来。

cues.en: So, this sum is equivalent to all the positive areas shown in green minus the sum of the negative areas shown in red. And this process results in a sort of net value, shown here as the size of this arrow.
cues.zh: 这个和等于绿色表示的所有正面积，减去红色表示的所有负面积之和；这个过程得到一个类似净值的量，在这里用箭头的大小表示。

cues.en: The thing is, if the frequency under examination is not present in the signal,
cues.zh: 问题在于，如果所检测的频率并不存在于信号中，

cues.en: the sum will generally be small, because the positive and negative values will sort of cancel each other out over time.
cues.zh: 总和通常会很小，因为正负值随着时间推移会相互抵消。

cues.en: However, if we do the same thing for a frequency which actually is present in signal,
cues.zh: 然而，如果对信号中实际存在的频率做同样的操作，

cues.en: the integration will yield a much larger net value.
cues.zh: 积分就会得到一个大得多的净值。

cues.en: And by repeating this multiplication and integration process for a large number of frequencies,
cues.zh: 通过对大量频率重复这种乘法和积分过程，

cues.en: we can construct a frequency spectrum.
cues.zh: 我们就能构建出一个频谱。

cues.en: And if you look at the spectrum here, you'll see that the signal is comprised of mainly three different frequencies.
cues.zh: 看这里的频谱，你会发现这个信号主要由三种不同的频率组成。

cues.en: So, this is the basic idea behind the Fourier transform.
cues.zh: 这就是傅里叶变换的基本原理。

cues.en: And with this in the back of our minds, I can very quickly illustrate how this process is described by the actual formula of the The
cues.zh: 有了这个认知，我就可以快速说明一下实际公式是如何描述这一过程的。

cues.en: spectrum
cues.zh: 频谱

cues.en: as a function of the frequency
cues.zh: 作为频率的函数，

cues.en: is equal
cues.zh: 等于

cues.en: to the signal as a function of time,
cues.zh: 时间函数表示的信号，

cues.en: times the sinusoidal
cues.zh: 乘以

cues.en: function with frequency f.
cues.zh: 频率为 f 的正弦函数。

cues.en: And this multiplication is integrated over time.
cues.zh: 然后将这个乘积在时间上进行积分。

cues.en: So, that is the process that I have just illustrated and basically the essence of the Fourier transform.
cues.zh: 这就是我刚才演示的过程，也是傅里叶变换的核心本质。

cues.en: But of course, it is not the full story.
cues.zh: 当然，这还不是全部。

cues.en: The main simplification I made in my example is that I used a very simple sinusoidal
cues.zh: 我在例子中所做的主要简化，是使用了一个非常简单的正弦

cues.en: function instead of the complex harmonic function presented here. And the key difference is that in the full formula, the resulting values of the transform are
cues.zh: 函数，而不是这里给出的复谐波函数。关键的区别在于，在完整公式中，变换得到的值是

cues.en: complex numbers.
cues.zh: 复数。

cues.en: And the resulting function does not only contain a simple amplitude value for each frequency, but also information about the phase for each frequency.
cues.zh: 而且得到的结果不仅包含每个频率的振幅值，还包含每个频率的相位信息。

cues.en: And with phase I refer to the relative starting point of each wave. And this is because not all frequencies in a signal have to exactly be in phase or start at the same point in time.
cues.zh: 这里所说的相位是指每个波的相对起点。这是因为信号中的所有频率并不一定完全同相，也不一定在同一时刻开始。

cues.en: But the reason why I ignored phase in the previous explanation is that in the optical Fourier transforms in this video, we do not observe phase directly.
cues.zh: 而在之前的解释中我忽略了相位，是因为本视频中的光学傅里叶变换无法直接观察到相位。

cues.en: But if you want to understand Fourier, it is good to realize that the result of a transformation contains both amplitude and phase information.
cues.zh: 但如果你想真正理解傅里叶变换，最好要明白变换结果同时包含了振幅和相位信息。

cues.en: And for those of you who want to dive a bit deeper,
cues.zh: 对于想要更深入了解的朋友，

cues.en: I will place a few links in the description.
cues.zh: 我会在简介里放一些链接。

cues.en: One of the beautiful aspects of the Fourier transform is that the process can also be reversed.
cues.zh: 傅里叶变换的美妙之处之一在于，这个过程也是可逆的。

cues.en: So, if we have the result of the Fourier transform,
cues.zh: 因此，如果我们有了傅里叶变换的结果，

cues.en: we can reproduce the original signal by just adding up all the different frequencies,
cues.zh: 只需将所有不同的频率相加，

cues.en: considering their amplitudes and phase values,
cues.zh: 结合它们的振幅和相位值，

cues.en: and then regenerate the original signal from the spectral data by just adding up all these waves.
cues.zh: 只需叠加所有这些波，就能从频谱数据中重新生成原始信号。

cues.en: And this process is called an inverse Fourier transform.
cues.zh: 这个过程就叫作逆傅里叶变换。

cues.en: The principle of Fourier transforms has very wide applications in signal processing and can for example also be used to calculate frequency spectra
cues.zh: 傅里叶变换原理在信号处理中应用非常广泛，比如还可以用来计算频谱，

cues.en: in visual information, like in images.
cues.zh: 用于像图像这样的视觉信息中。

cues.en: And in this case we consider spatial signal variations instead of temporal variations.
cues.zh: 这种情况下，我们考虑的是空间信号变化，而不是时间变化。

cues.en: Here you see an image that contains a grayscaled wave pattern that has a variable spatial frequency along the horizontal direction.
cues.zh: 这里你可以看到一张包含灰度波纹图案的图像，它的空间频率沿水平方向变化。

cues.en: The signal here is actually present in the grayscales of the pixels.
cues.zh: 这里的信号实际上体现在像素的灰度值中。

cues.en: So lighter values in the image represent high signal values and dark pixels represent low values, as is illustrated in this three d plot of the same image.
cues.zh: 图像中较亮的值代表高信号值，较暗的像素代表低信号值，正如这幅同一图像的 3D 图所示。

cues.en: But,
cues.zh: 但是，

cues.en: because an image is generally two dimensional, we also need a two d spectrum to represent the result of the transform.
cues.zh: 因为图像通常是二维的，所以我们也需要一个二维频谱来表示变换结果。

cues.en: If we apply a Fourier transform on this image, we get the following plot:
cues.zh: 如果我们对这张图像应用傅里叶变换，就会得到下面这张图：

cues.en: a thin symmetric bright line along the x axis.
cues.zh: 一条沿 x 轴对称的细亮线。

cues.en: And it represents all the frequencies present in the image in the X direction,
cues.zh: 它代表了图像中 X 方向上存在的所有频率，

cues.en: ranging from zero frequency,
cues.zh: 从零频开始，

cues.en: which is always in the center of this type of plot, to higher frequencies displayed further away from the center.
cues.zh: 零频总是在这类图的中心，而离中心越远就代表更高的频率。

cues.en: And when we have reached the maximum frequency present in the original image,
cues.zh: 当达到原始图像中存在的最高频率时，

cues.en: the spectral signal suddenly goes to zero, because there are no higher frequencies in the image.
cues.zh: 频谱信号会突然降为零，因为图像中没有更高的频率了。

cues.en: By the way, because of how they are calculated,
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，由于计算方式的原因，

cues.en: these plots are always symmetrical
cues.zh: 这些图始终是对称的，

cues.en: with respect to the center of the image.
cues.zh: 都是关于图像中心对称的。

cues.en: When moving along the Y axis in the Fourier transform, we see that only one single frequency is present, which is zero, so also in the center of the plot in the y direction.
cues.zh: 沿着傅里叶变换的 Y 轴移动时，可以看到只存在一个频率，即零频，也就是 y 方向上的中心位置。

cues.en: And this is because in the original image there are no intensity variations present when moving along lines parallel to the y axis.
cues.zh: 这是因为在原始图像中，沿平行于 y 轴的线条移动时没有任何强度变化。

cues.en: Fourier transforms can be applied on basically any image. And for humans, studying the Fourier transform is generally not very interesting. But for a computer that is a different story.
cues.zh: 傅里叶变换基本上可以应用于任何图像。对人类来说，研究傅里叶变换通常没什么意思，但对计算机来说就是另一回事了。

cues.en: So what a computer can do is calculate the Fourier transform of the image and then discard all the higher frequency information,
cues.zh: 计算机可以先计算出图像的傅里叶变换，然后丢弃所有高频信息，

cues.en: so the outside regions of the Fourier transform,
cues.zh: 也就是傅里叶变换的外围区域，

cues.en: and then do an inverse transform on the reduced data.
cues.zh: 接着对缩减后的数据执行逆变换。

cues.en: And as you can see, this results in a blurred version of the image.
cues.zh: 正如你所见，这会生成一张模糊的图像。

cues.en: The reason for this is that all the high frequencies required to reproduce the sharp edges have been removed from the spectral information.
cues.zh: 原因在于，重现清晰边缘所需的高频部分已经从频谱信息中被移除了。

cues.en: But we can also discard the lower frequencies by blackening out the center of the Fourier transform.
cues.zh: 但我们也可以通过将傅里叶变换的中心涂黑来丢弃低频。

cues.en: In this case, an inverse transform only shows the sharp outlines in the image that require the high frequencies to display.
cues.zh: 这种情况下，逆变换只会显示图像中需要高频才能呈现的清晰轮廓。

cues.en: Fourier transforms can also be used for pattern recognition.
cues.zh: 傅里叶变换也可以用于模式识别。

cues.en: So let's say we have this image containing the letter A and we calculate the Fourier transform.
cues.zh: 假设我们有一张包含字母 A 的图像，并对其计算傅里叶变换。

cues.en: If we place the A in different locations inside the image, the amplitudes of the Fourier transform will show exactly the same pattern,
cues.zh: 如果把 A 放在图像中的不同位置，傅里叶变换的幅值将呈现完全相同的图样，

cues.en: no matter where the A is located in the image.
cues.zh: 无论 A 位于图像中的哪个位置。

cues.en: And in addition, if we take an image with multiple characters, for example an A and a B, a computer would still be able to tell instantly that there is an a in the image, by just looking for the presence of specific frequencies in the two d spectrum.
cues.zh: 此外，如果我们拿一张包含多个字符的图像，比如 A 和 B，计算机只需在二维频谱中寻找特定频率是否存在，就能立刻判断出图像中有 A。

cues.en: Okay, now let's look at how we can do Fourier transforms using optics.
cues.zh: 好，现在来看看如何利用光学来实现傅里叶变换。

cues.en: And we will do this by using the optical equivalent of the cochlea,
cues.zh: 我们将通过使用耳蜗在光学上的等价物来做到这一点，

cues.en: which is a plane lens actually.
cues.zh: 实际上就是一个平面透镜。

cues.en: For a confocal lens, the plane at the focal distance of the lens is called the Fourier plane. And for good reasons, as I will show in a minute.
cues.zh: 对于共焦透镜，位于透镜焦距处的平面被称为傅里叶面。正如我马上要展示的，这么叫很有道理。

cues.en: So, let's say we start out with a uniform beam of light. Basically, a uniform beam contains just one spatial frequency,
cues.zh: 假设我们从一束均匀光束开始。基本上，均匀光束只包含一个空间频率，

cues.en: which is zero, because there are no intensity variations in the beam.
cues.zh: 那就是零，因为光束中没有光强变化。

cues.en: In this case, all the light is focused into one central spot in the Fourier plane.
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，所有的光都会聚焦在傅里叶面的中心点上。

cues.en: Next we place a mask in the beam containing transparent and non transparent areas.
cues.zh: 接着，我们在光束中放置一个包含透光和不透光区域的掩模。

cues.en: So we modulate the intensity of the beam, introducing
cues.zh: 这样我们就调制了光束的强度，引入了

cues.en: spatial frequencies other than zero.
cues.zh: 非零的空间频率。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.en: the mask will not only introduce intensity variations in the beam, but the edges in the pattern will also diffract the light in different directions.
cues.zh: 掩模不仅会引入光强变化，图案边缘还会将光衍射到不同方向。

cues.en: This changes the angle of a fraction of the light and steers it away from the central point.
cues.zh: 这改变了一部分光线的角度，使其偏离中心点。

cues.en: And the higher the spatial frequencies in the pattern, the stronger the light is projected away from the central point in the Fourier plane.
cues.zh: 图案中的空间频率越高，光在傅里叶面中被投射到偏离中心的位置就越强烈。

cues.en: Now, it is not trivial to see why the process of diffraction of light would yield exactly the same result as a Fourier transformation in the Fourier plane.
cues.zh: 要理解为什么光的衍射过程会在傅里叶面上产生与傅里叶变换完全相同的结果，其实并不直观。

cues.en: But if I had to explain it in just one sentence, the mathematics describing Fresnel diffraction phenomena is very similar to that of the Fourier transformation.
cues.zh: 但如果要用一句话来解释，那就是描述菲涅耳衍射现象的数学形式与傅里叶变换非常相似。

cues.en: Now, of course we want to observe how this works in practice. But it turns out that it is quite hard to demonstrate the effect when you use patterns that are relatively large compared to the wavelength of light.
cues.zh: 当然，我们想在实际中观察它是如何运作的。但事实证明，如果使用的图案尺寸相比光的波长偏大，就很难演示出这种效果。

cues.en: And in that case, the total amount of light diffracted by the edges will be very small compared to the amount that is passing sort of straight through your mask.
cues.zh: 在这种情况下，边缘衍射的光总量相比直接穿透掩模的光量会非常微弱。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: in the case of large patterns, there will be just one very bright spot in the center of the Fourier plane and maybe, if you are lucky, a few very dim patterns on the outside.
cues.zh: 在图案较大的情况下，傅里叶面中心就只会有一个极亮的斑点，运气好的话，外侧也许还能看到几道非常微弱的图样。

cues.en: However, if we use very small patterns, it becomes very easy to display the higher frequency information.
cues.zh: 但如果我们使用非常小的图案，显示高频信息就会变得很容易。

cues.en: And for this reason I decided to demonstrate the optical Fourier by using fairly small patterns.
cues.zh: 因此我决定用相当小的图案来演示光学傅里叶变换。

cues.en: So, I made transparent characters of approximately one fourth of a millimeter in size in a non transparent chromium mask.
cues.zh: 所以，我在不透明的铬掩模上制作了大约四分之一毫米大小的透明字符。

cues.en: And just as in the previous videos, I used the home built maskless wafer stepper to create these patterns in the chromium layer.
cues.zh: 就像之前的视频一样，我用自制的无掩模晶圆步进光刻机在铬层上制作了这些图案。

cues.en: Let me just show you the setup that I used to do the optical Fourier transforms.
cues.zh: 先来看看我用来做光学傅里叶变换的实验装置。

cues.en: It is actually extremely simple:
cues.zh: 它其实非常简单：

cues.en: as a light source I used a helium neon laser.
cues.zh: 光源我用的是氦氖激光器。

cues.en: The beam from the laser bounces off an adjustable mirror, which is basically used to control the direction of the beam.
cues.zh: 激光束经过一个可调节反射镜反射，主要用来控制光束方向。

cues.en: Then there is a pinhole of about 0.35 millimeters in diameter to limit the beam size a bit. Behind the pinhole is the mask that contains the different character patterns.
cues.zh: 然后是一个直径约 0.35 毫米的小孔，用来稍微限制一下光束大小。小孔后面就是包含不同字符图案的掩模。

cues.en: The last part of this setup is a camera with the lens close to the pattern mask. In this case, it is just a standard 50 millimeters lens focused at infinity.
cues.zh: 装置的最后一部分是一台相机，镜头紧贴着图案掩模。这里用的是一个标准的 50 毫米镜头，对焦在无穷远。

cues.en: So, by setting the focus of the lens to infinity,
cues.zh: 只要把镜头对焦在无穷远，

cues.en: the CMOS sensor is located automatically at the Fourier plane.
cues.zh: CMOS 传感器就会自动处于傅里叶面上。

cues.en: Now, let's have a look at the optical Fourier transforms of the different characters and compare them with the calculated spectra.
cues.zh: 现在，我们来看看不同字符的光学傅里叶变换，并将它们与计算出的频谱进行对比。

cues.en: Here you see three images:
cues.zh: 这里可以看到三张图像：

cues.en: left the original pattern containing the letter A,
cues.zh: 左边是包含字母 A 的原始图案，

cues.en: the calculated Fourier transform using software in the center and to the right the observed optical Fourier transform using the lens.
cues.zh: 中间是用软件计算出的傅里叶变换，右边是通过透镜观察到的光学傅里叶变换。

cues.en: It is actually amazing how the details in the images of theory and experiment match,
cues.zh: 理论与实验图像中的细节吻合度高得惊人，

cues.en: Apart from a few ghost reflections that are caused by glass interfaces,
cues.zh: 除了玻璃界面引起的一些重影反射外，

cues.en: they are basically identical.
cues.zh: 它们基本上是一模一样的。

cues.en: Here you see the same comparisons for a few other patterns and in all cases the optical diffraction patterns exactly match the theoretical images.
cues.zh: 这里展示了另外几种图案的相同对比，在所有情况下，光学衍射图样都与理论图像完全吻合。

cues.en: So, this very simple optical system performs a complex mathematical operation in very high detail.
cues.zh: 也就是说，这个极其简单的光学系统，以非常高的细节度完成了一项复杂的数学运算。

cues.en: And at an amazing speed.
cues.zh: 而且速度惊人。

cues.en: My modern Intel i5 PC takes about two seconds to calculate the fast Fourier transform of the original image.
cues.zh: 我那台现代的 Intel i5 电脑大约需要两秒钟来计算原始图像的快速傅里叶变换。

cues.en: But the lens actually does this in the time that it takes the light to travel from the mask to the Fourier plane,
cues.zh: 但透镜完成这一运算所需的时间，仅仅是光从掩模传播到傅里叶面的时间，

cues.en: which is 0.3 nanoseconds.
cues.zh: 只有 0.3 纳秒。

cues.en: This puts the fast of fast Fourier transform in a somewhat different perspective,
cues.zh: 这让人对“快速傅里叶变换”中的“快速”有了完全不同的认识，

cues.en: because the lens performs the task about 6,000,000,000
cues.zh: 因为透镜完成这项任务的速度，

cues.en: times faster than my computer.
cues.zh: 比我的电脑快了大约 60 亿倍。

cues.en: So how can we use this amazing speed to our advantage?
cues.zh: 那么我们该如何利用这种惊人的速度呢？

cues.en: Well, for example, we can use it to quickly identify patterns.
cues.zh: 比如，我们可以用它来快速识别图案。

cues.en: And we can do this by placing an optical filter at the Fourier plane.
cues.zh: 具体做法就是在傅里叶面上放置一个光学滤波器。

cues.en: Let's say we want to detect the letter A in a series of patterns.
cues.zh: 假设我们想在一系列图案中检测出字母 A。

cues.en: To do this, we create a filter based on the diffraction pattern of the character A.
cues.zh: 为此，我们基于字符 A 的衍射图样制作了一个滤波器。

cues.en: And here you see an example of such a filter pattern, where the white areas that the light pass and the black areas block the light. As you can see, this filter also contains an additional circular block in the center. And this is to remove most of the low frequencies and improve the discrimination sensitivity,
cues.zh: 这就是该滤波图案的一个示例，白色区域透光，黑色区域遮光。可以看到，这个滤波器中心还有一个额外的圆形遮挡，用来滤除大部分低频成分，从而提高分辨灵敏度，

cues.en: because most patterns still contain a relatively large amount of low spatial frequencies.
cues.zh: 因为大多数图案都含有相对较多的低空间频率。

cues.en: So, when the diffraction pattern of the letter A passes through the Fourier plane,
cues.zh: 因此，当字母 A 的衍射图样穿过傅里叶面时，

cues.en: most of the light will pass through the filter.
cues.zh: 大部分光线都会穿过该滤波器。

cues.en: However, if a different character passes through the image field, like for example the character B, much less light will pass the filter. So, by just measuring the total amount of light after filtering, for example with a fast photodiode,
cues.zh: 但如果是其他字符（比如字符 B）经过视场，透过的光就会少得多。所以，只要测量滤波后的总光量（例如用高速光电二极管），

cues.en: you could easily detect which image contains an A.
cues.zh: 就能轻松检测出哪幅图像包含 A。

cues.en: Let me show you how I attempted to do this experiment in practice.
cues.zh: 接下来我带大家看看我是如何在实际中做这个实验的。

cues.en: Basically, I replaced the camera of the original setup with a DLP projector.
cues.zh: 简单来说，我把原装置里的相机换成了一台 DLP 投影仪。

cues.en: So my Fourier filter is not transmissive but reflective.
cues.zh: 这样我的傅里叶滤波器就不是透射式的，而是反射式的。

cues.en: Only if the mirrors of the DLP projector are in the on state, they are tilted and send light in a specific off axis direction.
cues.zh: 只有当 DLP 投影仪的微镜处于“开”状态时，它们才会偏转，把光反射到特定的离轴方向。

cues.en: So, if we place a particular filter pattern on the DMD chip, we create a Fourier filter that reflects light in a specific direction.
cues.zh: 因此，如果我们在 DMD 芯片上加载特定的滤波图案，就能构建一个将光反射到特定方向的傅里叶滤波器。

cues.en: And that is exactly the direction where you can place a photodiode
cues.zh: 这个方向正好可以用来放置光电二极管，

cues.en: to detect the total amount of light after filtering.
cues.zh: 以便检测滤波后的总光量。

cues.en: Now here I placed a camera in the location of the photodiode,
cues.zh: 这里我在光电二极管的位置放了一台相机，

cues.en: so we can observe the filtering process in a more visual manner.
cues.zh: 这样我们就能更直观地观察滤波过程。

cues.en: The camera is connected to the PC that also controls the DMD chip.
cues.zh: 这台相机连着一台 PC，这台电脑同时也控制着 DMD 芯片。

cues.en: Basically, the DMD chip is configured to be the second screen of this computer.
cues.zh: 实际上，DMD 芯片被配置成了这台电脑的第二块屏幕。

cues.en: And here is the filter pattern I just showed you, opened in a window on the first screen.
cues.zh: 这就是我刚才展示的滤波图案，在第一块屏幕的窗口中打开。

cues.en: What I can do is slide the pattern over to the second screen of the PC, which is in fact the DMD chip. And because the camera image displays what is going on on this DMD chip, we can see the pattern simultaneously
cues.zh: 我可以把这个图案拖到电脑的第二块屏幕（也就是 DMD 芯片）上。既然相机的画面显示的是 DMD 芯片上的情况，那我们就能同时看到图案

cues.en: appear in the micro mirror surface as we slide it over to the second screen.
cues.zh: 在拖向第二块屏幕的同时，显现在微镜表面上。

cues.en: The Fourier transform currently projected by the lens on the DMD chip is the transform of the letter A.
cues.zh: 目前透镜投影在 DMD 芯片上的傅里叶变换正是字母 A 的变换。

cues.en: So we can sort of align the filter pattern with the actual Fourier signal to quickly maximize the amount of light for the letter A.
cues.zh: 这样我们就可以将滤波图案与实际的傅里叶信号对齐，迅速让字母 A 的透光量最大化。

cues.en: I must admit that the alignment is far from perfect: basically, I could not set the scaling of the filter image to the correct size.
cues.zh: 我得承认这次对齐远算不上完美：主要是滤波图像的缩放尺寸我没调到正好合适。

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 不管怎样，

cues.en: even without appropriate scaling, the differences in the amount of light reflected by various characters is pretty clear.
cues.zh: 即使不做适当缩放，不同字符反射的光量差异也非常明显。

cues.en: So now that the DMD is set up, we can discriminate between the letter A and other characters.
cues.zh: 既然 DMD 已经设置好了，我们就能区分字母 A 和其他字符。

cues.en: Using this principle, it is possible to do very fast pattern recognition.
cues.zh: 利用这个原理，就可以实现极速的模式识别。

cues.en: And the speed of the recognition is actually not limited by the DMD,
cues.zh: 而且识别速度实际上并不受限于 DMD，

cues.en: which just displays a static reference pattern in this case.
cues.zh: 因为在这种情况里它只是显示一个静态参考图案。

cues.en: Also, it is not limited by the photodiode,
cues.zh: 同样，它也不受限于光电二极管，

cues.en: because fast photodiodes can have a rise time of ten
cues.zh: 因为高速光电二极管的上升时间可以达到 10

cues.en: picoseconds.
cues.zh: 皮秒。

cues.en: Now, the speed of the recognition process is actually only limited by the time it takes to do the Fourier transform,
cues.zh: 此时，识别过程的速度实际上只取决于进行傅里叶变换所需的时间，

cues.en: which is in this case executed
cues.zh: 而在这种情况下它是以

cues.en: with the speed of light and only takes 0.3.
cues.zh: 光速完成的，仅仅耗时 0.3。

cues.en: Okay, that's it for this video. Hope you enjoyed it. Bye.
cues.zh: 好了，本期视频就到这里。希望大家喜欢，再见。
